    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:01.840
    | text      = Yeah, that's not true.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:04.480

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:05.279
    | text      = Works for me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:06.200
    | text      = I mean, I'm from Missouri, and there's like Versailles.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:10.159
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:13.240
    | text      = I don't care.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:15.279
    | text      = There's an X in that word.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:16.480
    | text      = It's Bexar.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:17.240
    | text      = Here's what I was thinking.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:18.440
    | text      = I was thinking buoy, nobody's ever
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:21.919
    | text      = going to call it a buoy knife.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:23.559
    | text      = And then I was thinking, you know what,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:25.120
    | text      = you should have just been buoy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:27.440
    | text      = And then I was writing out buoy in my head,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:29.600
    | text      = and I was like, yeah, put a W in there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:31.360
    | text      = B-O-O-I-E, that's no good.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:34.240
    | text      = You don't want to write that out for the rest of your life.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:36.559
    | text      = No.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:37.600
    | text      = But that X.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:39.600
    | text      = It's not fair.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:40.519
    | text      = So this week, Jordan, I made the interesting choice
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:43.600
    | text      = of watching Trump's State of the Union speech.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:45.679
    | text      = Oh, god.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:46.399
    | text      = And for a moment, I considered the idea of doing
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:48.399
    | text      = an episode just about that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:49.759
    | text      = I was pretty close.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:51.679
    | text      = It was one of the most nakedly hostile and dictatorish
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:54.399
    | text      = displays I've seen in my life.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:56.000
    | text      = And the spectacle of these hundreds
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:12:57.919
    | text      = of oh-so-serious politicians just sitting by
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:00.799
    | text      = and being part of it was too much to handle.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:03.200
    | text      = Hilarious.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:04.000
    | text      = It was grotesque.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:05.519
    | text      = Yeah, I bet.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:06.559
    | text      = Watching it, I had a bit of a realization
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:08.440
    | text      = that may be overdue, which is that I
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:11.399
    | text      = hate what is now politics.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:13.480
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:14.200
    | text      = I didn't come doing this show because
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:16.519
    | text      = of an interest in politics.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:17.879
    | text      = I didn't study political science in college.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:20.120
    | text      = But I've learned a fair amount about the subject
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:22.039
    | text      = in the process.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:22.919
    | text      = And I'm fucking sick of what this has become.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:24.919
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:25.799
    | text      = I'm interested in rights and people
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:27.799
    | text      = being allowed and enabled to live the lives that they
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:30.279
    | text      = want to live.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:31.320
    | text      = I'm interested in how we can organize society better
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:34.320
    | text      = to maximize that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:35.399
    | text      = And I'm interested in figures in the media space who's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:38.279
    | text      = only real function is to lie to everyone
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:40.759
    | text      = to make it impossible for us to improve anything.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:43.559
    | text      = I'm interested in those things.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:45.559
    | text      = And I think for a while, I've had a belief
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:47.639
    | text      = that politics was the most disciplined and effective way
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:50.360
    | text      = to do the work of organizing society in a way that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:53.080
    | text      = maximizes rights and people's freedoms
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:55.320
    | text      = to make choices themselves.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:13:57.080
    | text      = But watching that fucking State of the Union,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:00.120
    | text      = I don't know if that feels accurate anymore.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:02.639
    | text      = Maybe it was never a useful avenue for that pursuit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:06.240
    | text      = Or maybe things have gotten worse in the past 15 years.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:09.679
    | text      = I'm not sure, and I don't care.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:11.159
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:11.639
    | text      = But I know that watching that State of the Union
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:13.639
    | text      = made me certain that our structure of government
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:16.120
    | text      = does not have an effective answer for what Trump is doing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:19.440
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:19.960
    | text      = That was fucking outrageous.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:22.840
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:23.320
    | text      = It was 10 steps past unacceptable.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:25.600
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:26.759
    | text      = Nasty malevolent creeps have essentially
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:29.000
    | text      = seized the power of our government
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:30.720

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:32.519
    | text      = who's willing to listen that they don't care
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:34.639
    | text      = about checks on their power.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:35.799
    | text      = Nah, that doesn't sound true.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:37.000
    | text      = I can't imagine what message you're
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:39.080
    | text      = supposed to take away from this other than we intend
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:42.000
    | text      = to stay in power no matter what.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:43.440
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:43.919
    | text      = Fuck all of you.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:44.840
    | text      = Obviously.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:45.600
    | text      = Any attempt to stop them from attacking other countries
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:49.000
    | text      = or rigging the economy is going to be
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:50.799
    | text      = treated as a treasonous attack on American prosperity.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:53.679
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:54.200
    | text      = Any attempt to run a fair election against them
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = is going to be treated as an attempted coup.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:14:58.399
    | text      = Yep.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:02.240
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:03.440
    | text      = At people in this speech.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:05.559
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:06.039
    | text      = Horrifying.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:06.720
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:07.600
    | text      = You know what I was thinking?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:08.840
    | text      = I was thinking on the walk over here, oh, man,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:11.279
    | text      = I wish I was W. Man, he is fucking,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:15.759
    | text      = his legacy is so saved.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:18.360
    | text      = Like, this guy should have gone down
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:19.840
    | text      = in history as the single worst president who lied us
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:22.879
    | text      = into a war, who's a fucking monster, a serial killer,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:25.879
    | text      = a murderer, a horrible fucking person.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:28.320
    | text      = Now everybody's going to be like, he wasn't that bad.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:30.519
    | text      = It's almost impossible to rate politicians

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:34.679
    | text      = on a scale that includes this anymore.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:37.039

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:45.360
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:45.960
    | text      = And so when I was watching that, I realized something,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:49.320
    | text      = or something clicked over.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:50.799
    | text      = And I just realized that whatever this is is not what
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:15:58.000
    | text      = it's, like, the place that it's existing in.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:01.080
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:02.320
    | text      = The State of the Union, the president, Congress, all this,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:05.840
    | text      = that is no longer what a politic is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:09.360
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:11.039
    | text      = This is a fucking extended, not very interesting clan rally.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:17.519
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:18.039
    | text      = That some people are humoring.

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:21.480
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:22.000
    | text      = I mean, I suppose that my entire political adult life,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:25.159
    | text      = I felt like I was being gaslit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:27.799
    | text      = But now, most people feel like they're being gaslit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:30.679
    | text      = So I don't feel as alone.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:33.240
    | text      = So that's nice.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:37.519
    | text      = After watching it, I was like, well, we should probably

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = talk about Alex's response to that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:16:41.360
    | text      = But I'm not quite ready to after having taken it in and sat

    | text      = Oh, yes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:39.900
    | text      = So we'll go over this a little bit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:41.460
    | text      = But we are kicking their teeth in.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:43.059
    | text      = We're knocking their teeth out.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:44.900

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:47.259

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:48.500

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:51.700
    | text      = Cool.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:52.539
    | text      = So this is a great encapsulation of Alex's sense
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:55.019
    | text      = of what he's doing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:56.460
    | text      = He's part of the truth-telling media.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:23:58.579
    | text      = But that media is also super popular
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:01.099
    | text      = because it's telling you what you know in your gut.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:04.059
    | text      = The truth of what feels right, what you think must be right,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:08.619
    | text      = is far more true than someone reporting about an event
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:11.500
    | text      = that's actually happening.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:13.380
    | text      = They're trying to lie to you with facts and statistics,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:16.140
    | text      = whereas Alex is telling you the truth through vibes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:19.220
    | text      = And this is dumb.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:20.619
    | text      = Well, the headline that Alex bases this little riff on
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:23.740
    | text      = is actually a little confusing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:26.059
    | text      = But it was just Rupert Murdoch giving a speech
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:28.339
    | text      = at the annual Livery Lecture at the worshipful company
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:32.380
    | text      = of stationers and newspaper makers in London,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:35.099
    | text      = mostly about how the internet was transforming media
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:37.579
    | text      = from a business that created a thing for consumers
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:40.500
    | text      = to a thing that catered to consumers' demands.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:43.539
    | text      = This is mostly discussed in terms of the pivot
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:45.700
    | text      = from newspapers that were primarily print
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:47.779
    | text      = to news outlets that focused a lot
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:49.500
    | text      = on online articles and apps.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:52.259
    | text      = It comes off as a reassuring speech meant to argue
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:55.380
    | text      = that high-quality content will always win the day
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:24:58.220
    | text      = and that the existing media companies should rise
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:00.619
    | text      = to the challenge that the internet presents.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:03.700
    | text      = With hindsight, I read this speech
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:05.539
    | text      = as a deludedly optimistic view.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:08.299
    | text      = The dynamic that Murdoch is talking about,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:10.900
    | text      = where the power and influence in the media
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:12.299
    | text      = is held not by the reporters or editors,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:14.660
    | text      = but by the whims of the consumer,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:16.420
    | text      = is basically what we're living in now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:18.619
    | text      = Media companies, both old and new,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:20.500
    | text      = have made themselves slaves to the clicks
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:22.380
    | text      = and artificial traffic that social media appears to provide.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:25.579
    | text      = And in the process, they've allowed a small number
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:28.019
    | text      = of lunatic consumers to have outsized influence
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:30.819
    | text      = on what the rest of us has to live with
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:33.099
    | text      = as our prevailing culture.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:34.660
    | text      = Yep, pretty much exactly that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:36.059
    | text      = And that's the opposite of what I think Rupert Murdoch
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:40.420
    | text      = was hoping for in that speech.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:42.940
    | text      = Yeah, I mean, you know,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:46.259

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:25:55.460

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Like he bought a big chunk of the internet.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:03.380
    | text      = He did.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:04.220
    | text      = You know, and then he was like,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:26:56.220

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:27:55.460

    | text      = We might get 30 responses.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:44:13.920
    | text      = But you do something on the web, hundreds.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:44:15.920
    | text      = Again, the old line media is a hoax.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:44:18.559
    | text      = So the argument Alex is trying to make
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:44:20.300
    | text      = can be diagrammed like this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:44:22.320
    | text      = Premise one, if I get more job applicants
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:44:25.199
    | text      = through using Craigslist than through the newspaper,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:44:27.639
    | text      = then the media is a hoax.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:44:29.559
    | text      = Premise two, I have gotten more job applicants
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:44:32.440
    | text      = through Craigslist than through newspapers.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:44:34.599
    | text      = Conclusion, therefore the media is a hoax.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:44:37.780
    | text      = Logically, this is all valid.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:44:39.440
    | text      = The premises are set up in a way that if they're true,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:44:42.079
    | text      = then there's no way for that conclusion to be false.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:44:44.519
    | text      = And this dynamic is one of the ways that Alex's audience,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:44:47.760
    | text      = they just subconsciously end up thinking
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:44:49.840
    | text      = he's making more sense than he actually is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:44:52.800
    | text      = The first premise in his argument is fundamentally flawed.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:44:56.000
    | text      = So although this argument can be valid,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:44:58.000
    | text      = it can never be sound.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:44:59.880
    | text      = It's not possible for the first premise to be true
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:45:02.400
    | text      = because the number of job applicants
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:45:04.320
    | text      = you get from a certain source has no inherent connection
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:45:07.199
    | text      = to whether or not the media is a hoax.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:45:10.219
    | text      = When you hear an argument like this,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:45:11.880
    | text      = it's a good idea to search for unspoken or implied premises.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:45:16.199
    | text      = Sometimes the person making the argument
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:45:18.159
    | text      = is trying to hide something about what they're arguing,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:45:20.480
    | text      = but sometimes they're just lazy and bad at thinking,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:45:23.039
    | text      = so they come up with dumb shit like this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:45:25.559
    | text      = I highlighted this example
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:45:26.960
    | text      = because there's at least one very obvious hidden premise
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:45:30.599
    | text      = that Alex isn't saying that he needs
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:45:32.699
    | text      = for this argument to make sense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:45:34.760
    | text      = He needs to have a premise included
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:45:36.599
    | text      = that illustrates how getting more job applicants
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:45:40.199
    | text      = makes something a hoax.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:45:41.639
    | text      = Ideally, a premise that defines what it even means
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:45:44.980
    | text      = for something to be a hoax.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:45:46.900
    | text      = Once you start to tease that question out,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:45:49.059
    | text      = it begins to look like the hoax
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:45:51.260
    | text      = is that the media pretends more people
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:45:53.539
    | text      = are reading the newspaper,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:45:55.179
    | text      = whereas more people actually respond to Craigslist ads.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:45:58.840
    | text      = The hoax is about audience size,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:46:01.820
    | text      = and that's implied but not included in his argument.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:46:06.579
    | text      = So it appears that what Alex is saying
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:46:08.260
    | text      = is that he's gotten more job applicants from Craigslist
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:46:11.219
    | text      = than through the classified ads in the newspaper,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:46:13.500
    | text      = so he's concluded that the newspapers
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:46:15.260
    | text      = are far less influential than they claim to be.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:46:18.820
    | text      = But immediately it becomes clear how dumb that argument is
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:46:21.539

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:46:24.019

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:46:27.579

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:46:29.139

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:46:35.699
    | text      = and Craigslist did that more effectively,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:46:38.260
    | text      = then Alex's argument starts to hold up,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:46:40.820
    | text      = but Craigslist didn't do journalism.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:46:43.340

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:46:45.360

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:46:52.940
    | text      = Yeah, so I think that when you're analyzing

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
